metaDescription: Order custom sustainable lanyards and badges for your brand. Eco-friendly materials, bulk pricing, and fast turnaround from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom sustainable lanyards and badges made from recycled PET or organic cotton help your organization reduce plastic waste while keeping IDs and credentials accessible. They are a practical choice for eco-conscious companies, trade shows, and events that want to align their promotional products with their sustainability goals. Choose from eco-friendly materials, full-color imprinting, and breakaway safety features.
